title: 跟室友把話講開
subtitle: 12 句英文，不吵架也能說清楚

lines.say: Morning! Ah, I'll do those dishes later.
lines.zh: 早安！啊，那些碗我晚點洗。

lines.say: Grand. No worries.
lines.zh: 好，沒關係。

lines.say: Later meant never. For three weeks I said no worries, and for three weeks I was very, very worried.
lines.zh: 「晚點」就是永遠不會。三個星期我都說沒關係，三個星期我都非常有關係。

lines.say: Then one night I exploded about a frying pan. It was not my finest moment.
lines.zh: 然後某天晚上，我為了一個平底鍋爆炸了。那不是我最光彩的時刻。

board.cta: 跟室友把話講開・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for living with other people.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你跟別人一起住要用的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for living with other people.

lines.say: How to bring up a problem early, say how you feel without blaming, and agree on simple rules.
lines.zh: 怎麼早點提出問題、表達感受但不指責、一起訂簡單的規則。

scenes.title: Bring it up
scenes.sub: 開口：挑對時機，輕輕帶入

lines.say: Part one: bring it up.
lines.zh: 第一段：開口。

lines.say: The best time is when you're both calm. Not at midnight, not next to the dirty pan.
lines.zh: 最好的時機是兩個人都冷靜的時候。不是半夜，也不是站在髒鍋子旁邊。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: Have you got a sec? There's something I've been meaning to mention.
scenes.meaning: 你有空嗎？有件事我一直想跟你提
scenes.note: I've been meaning to ＝ 我一直想要……

lines.say: Have you got a sec? There's something I've been meaning to mention.
I've been meaning to means I wanted to do this for a while, but didn't.
lines.zh: I've been meaning to 是我想做這件事很久了，只是一直沒做。

lines.say: It also tells them: this is not a sudden attack. It's been on my mind.
lines.zh: 也讓對方知道：這不是突然發難，是我想了一陣子。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Have you got a sec? There's something I've been meaning to mention.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: It's not a big deal, but it's starting to bother me.
scenes.meaning: 不是什麼大事，但開始讓我有點困擾

lines.say: Then set the size of the problem.
lines.zh: 接著設定問題的大小。

lines.say: It's not a big deal, but it's starting to bother me.
Not a big deal makes it light. But starting to bother me is honest.
lines.zh: not a big deal 讓氣氛輕鬆，starting to bother me 則很誠實。

lines.say: Small problems are easy to fix. Three-week problems are not.
lines.zh: 小問題很好解決，拖三週的問題就難了。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: It's not a big deal, but it's starting to bother me.

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: I'd rather say something now than let it build up.
scenes.meaning: 我寧願現在說，也不想讓它累積
scenes.note: let it build up ＝ 讓它累積

lines.say: And explain why you're bringing it up at all.
lines.zh: 再說明你為什麼要提。

lines.say: I'd rather say something now than let it build up.
Build up means grow bigger slowly, like dishes in the sink.
lines.zh: build up 是慢慢累積，就像水槽裡的碗。

lines.say: This sentence makes talking sound like the kind choice. Because it is.
lines.zh: 這句話讓開口聽起來是體貼的選擇，因為它本來就是。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'd rather say something now than let it build up.

scenes.title: Say it kindly
scenes.sub: 說感受：用「我」開頭，不用「你總是」

lines.say: Part two: say it kindly.
lines.zh: 第二段：好好說。

lines.say: One small word changes everything. Start with I, not you.
lines.zh: 一個小字就能改變一切：用 I 開頭，不要用 you。

lines.say: You never wash anything is an attack. Your flatmate will defend himself.
lines.zh: 「你從來不洗」是攻擊，室友只會開始辯解。

lines.say: Talk about how it affects you. Nobody can argue with your feelings.
lines.zh: 講它對你的影響。沒有人能反駁你的感受。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: I find it hard to cook when the sink's full.
scenes.meaning: 水槽滿了的時候，我很難煮飯
scenes.note: I find it hard to ＝ 我覺得很難……

lines.say: I find it hard to cook when the sink's full.
I find it hard to talks about your experience, not their character.
lines.zh: I find it hard to 講的是你的經驗，不是對方的人格。

lines.say: And it gives a real reason: you need the sink.
lines.zh: 而且有具體理由：你需要用水槽。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I find it hard to cook when the sink's full.

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: I'm sure you don't mean to, but it's been happening a lot.
scenes.meaning: 我相信你不是故意的，但最近很常發生
scenes.note: I'm sure you don't mean to ＝ 我相信你不是故意的

lines.say: Give them the benefit of the doubt.
lines.zh: 先往好的方向假設。

lines.say: I'm sure you don't mean to, but it's been happening a lot.
I'm sure you don't mean to gives them an easy way out. Nobody likes to feel accused.
lines.zh: 這句給對方台階下。沒有人喜歡被指控。

lines.say: But the second half keeps the facts clear. A lot is a lot.
lines.zh: 但後半句把事實講清楚：很常就是很常。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I'm sure you don't mean to, but it's been happening a lot.

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: Is there anything I do that annoys you? Be honest.
scenes.meaning: 我有什麼讓你不爽的地方嗎？老實說

lines.say: And then, the bravest sentence of today.
lines.zh: 然後是今天最勇敢的一句。

lines.say: Is there anything I do that annoys you? Be honest.
Living together goes both ways. Maybe you play music at two in the morning!
lines.zh: 住在一起是雙向的。說不定你凌晨兩點在放音樂！

lines.say: When you ask this, the conversation becomes fair. And fair conversations work.
lines.zh: 問了這句，對話就變公平了。公平的對話才有用。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Is there anything I do that annoys you? Be honest.
Let's try the kind version.
lines.zh: 我們試試好好說的版本。

lines.say: Have you got a sec? There's something I've been meaning to mention.
lines.zh: 你有空嗎？有件事我一直想跟你提。

lines.say: Sure. What's up?
lines.zh: 好啊，怎麼了？

lines.say: It's not a big deal, but I find it hard to cook when the sink's full.
lines.zh: 不是什麼大事，但水槽滿了的時候，我很難煮飯。

lines.say: Oh. Yeah, sorry, I've been working late.
lines.zh: 喔，對，抱歉，我最近都加班。

lines.say: I'm sure you don't mean to. Is there anything I do that annoys you? Be honest.
lines.zh: 我相信你不是故意的。我有什麼讓你不爽的地方嗎？老實說。

lines.say: Well… you do sing in the shower. Very loudly.
lines.zh: 嗯……你洗澡會唱歌，很大聲。

lines.say: Fair enough! Now we both have something to fix.
lines.zh: 說得對！現在我們都有要改的地方了。

scenes.title: Agree on rules
scenes.sub: 訂規則：具體、公平、寫下來

lines.say: Part three: agree on rules.
lines.zh: 第三段：訂規則。

lines.say: Feelings are shared. Now turn them into something simple you can both follow.
lines.zh: 感受說完了，接著變成兩個人都做得到的簡單規則。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: How about we each wash our own stuff before bed?
scenes.meaning: 我們各自睡前把自己的東西洗好，怎麼樣？
scenes.note: How about we ＋ 原形動詞 ＝ 我們……如何

lines.say: How about we each wash our own stuff before bed?
How about we suggests a shared plan. Notice the verb stays simple: wash.
lines.zh: How about we 是提議一起做，後面動詞用原形 wash。

lines.say: Before bed is a clear time. Later is not a time.
lines.zh: 睡前是明確的時間，「晚點」不是時間。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: How about we each wash our own stuff before bed?

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: Should we set up a rota for the bins and the bathroom?
scenes.meaning: 我們要不要排個值日表，輪流倒垃圾和打掃浴室？

lines.say: For jobs nobody wants, take turns.
lines.zh: 沒人想做的事，就輪流。

lines.say: Should we set up a rota for the bins and the bathroom?
A rota is a list of who does what, and when. It's a very Irish and British word.
lines.zh: rota 是誰在什麼時候做什麼的表，是很英式和愛爾蘭的字。

lines.say: Put it on the fridge. Then nobody has to remember, or remind.
lines.zh: 貼在冰箱上，就沒人需要記，也沒人需要提醒。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Should we set up a rota for the bins and the bathroom?

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: Let's try it for a couple of weeks and see how it goes.
scenes.meaning: 我們先試兩個禮拜，看看效果如何
scenes.note: see how it goes ＝ 看看情況如何

lines.say: And make it a trial, not a law.
lines.zh: 把它當成試用，不是法律。

lines.say: Let's try it for a couple of weeks and see how it goes.
A couple of weeks means about two weeks. See how it goes means check if it works.
lines.zh: a couple of weeks 是大約兩週，see how it goes 是看看行不行得通。

lines.say: People agree more easily to something that's only for now.
lines.zh: 只是暫時的，大家比較容易答應。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Let's try it for a couple of weeks and see how it goes.

scenes.title: Small daily things
scenes.sub: 日常小事：借東西、帶朋友、安靜時間

lines.say: Part four: small daily things.
lines.zh: 第四段：日常小事。

lines.say: Most flatmate fights aren't about big things. They're about milk, guests and noise.
lines.zh: 大部分室友吵架都不是為了大事，而是牛奶、客人和噪音。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: Can I borrow some milk? I'll replace it tomorrow.
scenes.meaning: 你介意我借點牛奶嗎？我明天補給你

lines.say: Can I borrow some milk? I'll replace it tomorrow.
Ask first, and say when you'll replace it. Two small things that build trust.
lines.zh: 先問，再說什麼時候補。兩件小事，建立信任。

lines.say: Milk disappearing without a word is the number one flatmate crime.
lines.zh: 牛奶默默消失，是室友間的頭號罪行。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Can I borrow some milk? I'll replace it tomorrow.

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: Just a heads-up, I've got a friend staying on Saturday.
scenes.meaning: 先跟你說一聲，我星期六有朋友要來住

lines.say: And give a warning before you bring someone home.
lines.zh: 帶人回家前，先打聲招呼。

lines.say: Just a heads-up, I've got a friend staying on Saturday.
A heads-up is a short warning in advance, so nobody gets a surprise.
lines.zh: heads-up 是事先通知，讓大家不會被嚇到。

lines.say: Especially if your flatmate likes walking around in a towel.
lines.zh: 尤其是你室友喜歡只圍一條浴巾走來走去的時候。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Just a heads-up, I've got a friend staying on Saturday.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: Could you keep it down after eleven? I'm up early for work.
scenes.meaning: 十一點以後可以小聲一點嗎？我要早起上班
scenes.note: keep it down ＝ 小聲一點

lines.say: And the noise one.
lines.zh: 還有噪音這件事。

lines.say: Could you keep it down after eleven? I'm up early for work.
Keep it down means make less noise. Add a reason, and it doesn't sound like a complaint.
lines.zh: keep it down 是小聲一點。加上理由，就不像在抱怨。

lines.say: After eleven gives a clear limit. Clear limits are easy to respect.
lines.zh: 「十一點以後」是清楚的界線，清楚的界線最容易被尊重。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could you keep it down after eleven? I'm up early for work.
How about we each wash our own stuff before bed?
lines.zh: 我們各自睡前把自己的東西洗好，怎麼樣？

lines.say: Deal. And should we set up a rota for the bins?
lines.zh: 成交。那要不要排個倒垃圾的值日表？

lines.say: Good idea. Let's try it for a couple of weeks and see how it goes.
lines.zh: 好主意。我們先試兩個禮拜，看看效果如何。

lines.say: Perfect. And I'll buy some earplugs for your singing.
lines.zh: 太好了。我也會去買耳塞，擋你的歌聲。

lines.say: Ha! Fair enough.
lines.zh: 哈！好吧，算你有理。

lines.say: Problem solved, and we're still friends.
lines.zh: 問題解決了，我們還是朋友。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：家裡會聽到的兩句

lines.say: One more thing! Two things you'll hear in an Irish house.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！愛爾蘭家裡會聽到的兩句話。

lines.say: A tip is a rubbish dump. So when a room is very messy, we say this.
lines.zh: tip 是垃圾場。房間很亂時，我們這樣說。

lines.say: The place is a tip!
Every Irish mother has said it at least once a week.
lines.zh: 每個愛爾蘭媽媽每週至少說一次。

lines.say: And after any difficult conversation in Ireland, someone says this.
lines.zh: 在愛爾蘭，任何不好開口的談話結束後，總會有人說這句。

lines.say: I'll stick the kettle on.
Stick it on means turn it on. Tea means peace.
lines.zh: stick it on 是打開。泡茶就代表和好了。

lines.say: I'll stick the kettle on!

scenes.title: All together
scenes.sub: 總複習：在爆炸之前說出口

lines.say: Back to that kitchen, before the frying pan. Say my lines with me!
lines.zh: 回到廚房，在平底鍋事件之前。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: Morning! Ah, I'll do those dishes later.
lines.zh: 早安！啊，那些碗我晚點洗。

lines.say: Have you got a sec? There's something I've been meaning to mention.
lines.zh: 你有空嗎？有件事我一直想跟你提。

lines.say: Sure.
lines.zh: 好啊。

lines.say: I'd rather say something now than let it build up. I find it hard to cook when the sink's full.
lines.zh: 我寧願現在說，也不想讓它累積。水槽滿了的時候，我很難煮飯。

lines.say: Fair enough. I'll do them now.
lines.zh: 有道理，我現在就洗。

lines.say: Thanks. I'll stick the kettle on.
lines.zh: 謝謝，我去燒水泡茶。

items: Have you got a sec? There's something I've been meaning to mention.
It's not a big deal, but it's starting to bother me.
I'd rather say something now than let it build up.
I find it hard to cook when the sink's full.
I'm sure you don't mean to, but it's been happening a lot.
Is there anything I do that annoys you? Be honest.
How about we each wash our own stuff before bed?
Should we set up a rota for the bins and the bathroom?
Let's try it for a couple of weeks and see how it goes.
Can I borrow some milk? I'll replace it tomorrow.
Just a heads-up, I've got a friend staying on Saturday.
Could you keep it down after eleven? I'm up early for work.

lines.say: Clean sink, happy flat. Well done!
lines.zh: 水槽乾淨，家裡和平。做得好！

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them, or stick them on the fridge.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡。截圖，或貼在冰箱上。

items: 📰 每天一則在地新聞練英文
🎮 單字小遊戲，約朋友一起玩
🔥 連續打卡、解鎖稱號、逛廣場
🎓 英文小教室：會話、片語、文法

lines.say: Before you go! Do you want to practise English a little every day?
lines.zh: 走之前！想每天都練一點英文嗎？

lines.say: Try BinBin. Every day, there's a short news story from where you live, with the hard words explained.
lines.zh: 試試 BinBin。每天一則你所在地區的短新聞，難的單字都有解釋。

lines.say: Then play quick word games, on your own or with your friends.
lines.zh: 接著玩快速的單字小遊戲，自己玩或約朋友一起。

lines.say: Keep your streak going, unlock new titles, and say hi to other learners in the plaza.
lines.zh: 保持連續打卡、解鎖新稱號，還能在廣場跟其他學習者打招呼。

lines.say: And there are more lessons like this one, right inside the app.
lines.zh: App 裡還有更多像這樣的英文小教室。

lines.say: Go to binbindaily dot com, or tap the link below.
lines.zh: 上 binbindaily.com，或點下面的連結。
lines.cap: Go to binbindaily.com, or tap the link below.

lines.say: Now, I'll stick the kettle on. See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 好，我去燒水泡茶了。下一課見，Bye！
